eligibility.quote: It seems that the problem come from the bumper2pc node, because if I comment the include tag corresponding to the bumper2pc I don't get the error... Moreover if I connect the Kobuki base to my desktop computer, I can start the script and everything works perfectly. All packages are up to date on both computers.

failed_conditions.quote:
Case 1: Structures having Eigen objects as members
Adding EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW to class declaration solves the problem

resolution.quote: We fixed it and released just now. New version should be available soon on shadow-fix repo. Thanks for your inputs!

notes: Verified this session: kobuki#257 body verbatim (the Eigen DenseStorage.h:69 assertion, '[FATAL] ... Service call failed!', '[mobile_base_nodelet_manager-5] process has died [pid 26924, exit code -6, ...]', '[bumper2pointcloud-9] process has died [pid 27236, exit code 255, ...]') and all comments (corot comment 18128700 verbatim at 2013-05-20T01:28:13Z, ten minutes after commit 18b46dc at 2013-05-20T01:18:08Z; stonier's pointer to the Eigen docs; the ecl follow-ups). The archived ROS Answers thread (wayback) verified the reporter's statements verbatim: 'if I comment the include tag corresponding to the bumper2pc I don't get the error', 'All packages are up to date on both computers', 'the model of my laptop is : Asus Eee PC 1025C', 'On the robot's laptop (Asus) I have a 32 bits OS installed', and jorge's answer (2013-05-21 19:39:24 -0600 = 2013-05-22 UTC) used as the resolution quote. Code verified: 18b46dc patch adds EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW to Bumper2PcNodelet; tag 0.3.7 header has 'pcl::PointCloud<pcl::PointXYZ> pointcloud_' (line 86) and no EIGEN macro; tag 0.3.8 header has 'EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW' (line 76). Eligibility: the failure depends on the alignment contract between the consumer's heap-allocated plugin object and Eigen's requirement for fixed-size vectorizable members — an inter-unit API assumption, not one unit's own logic — and the resolving edit inside the consumer does not make it internal under E2 step 2; stop at 6, library API. Class 'other' concurs: representation_convention's enumeration targets value encodings (byte order/handedness/encoding), not object alignment; no named class fits an ABI/alignment precondition. Loudness loud_documented/activate: the provider's own assert fires during nodelet construction in the load service call, before topic traffic. Resolution observed: corot's same-day 'solves the problem' plus jorge's 'We fixed it and released just now.' attest the resolved composition; the spec's caveat (Eigen revision of the maintainers' 32-bit test machine not stated; reporter did not confirm) is accurate and disclosed. The Eigen 3.0.5 revision inference (Ubuntu precise) was not re-verified against eigen source; it does not affect the four adjudicated dimensions.
